items.exampleEn: Keep the tray balanced so the cups don't fall off.
items.exampleZh: 把托盤端平，杯子才不會掉下來。

items.exampleEn: Wearing sunglasses at night looks a bit bizarre.
items.exampleZh: 晚上戴墨鏡看起來有點怪。

items.exampleEn: The test was reasonably easy, so most students passed.
items.exampleZh: 那次考試相當簡單，所以大部分學生都及格了。

items.exampleEn: The twins look remarkably alike, even to their parents.
items.exampleZh: 那對雙胞胎長得出奇地像，連他們的爸媽都分不太出來。

items.exampleEn: She left the party abruptly without a word to anyone.
items.exampleZh: 她一句話也沒跟人說，就突然離開了派對。

items.exampleEn: The problem became more acute when two more workers left.
items.exampleZh: 又有兩名員工離職後，問題變得更嚴重了。

items.exampleEn: The old factory looks grim and dark from the outside.
items.exampleZh: 那座老工廠從外面看起來陰沉又灰暗。

items.exampleEn: He had a distinguished career as a pilot.
items.exampleZh: 他擔任飛行員的職業生涯非常傑出。

items.sentenceEn: The car stopped abruptly when a dog ran into the road.
items.sentenceZh: 一隻狗衝到路上，車子突然停了下來。

items.audioEn: The new phone works reasonably well, but the battery is weak.
items.audioZh: 這支新手機用起來還算不錯，但電池不太耐用。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得新手機怎麼樣？
options: Fairly good, apart from the battery
The battery lasts a long time

items.sentenceEn: The news on TV tonight was rather grim.
items.sentenceZh: 今晚電視上的新聞相當令人沮喪。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather is a distinguished painter who has won many prizes.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺是一位得過許多獎的傑出畫家。

items.stemEn: The newspaper tries to give a ____ view of both sides in every story.
items.stemZh: 那家報紙在每篇報導中都力求平衡呈現雙方的觀點。

items.stemEn: There is an ____ need for more teachers in small villages.
items.stemZh: 小村莊非常迫切需要更多老師。

items.passageEn: Last Friday, a distinguished scientist who has devoted thirty years to studying animals gave a talk at our school. She began with a bizarre fact: some frogs freeze in winter and come back to life in spring. She also explained that dogs have a remarkably acute sense of smell, much stronger than ours. Her talk was well balanced, with funny stories and serious information. Near the end, her face became grim as she showed photos of forests that had been cut down. Then the fire alarm went off for a test, and the talk ended abruptly. Luckily, the tickets for her next talk are reasonably priced, so we can attend it too.
items.passageZh: 上週五，一位投入三十年研究動物的傑出科學家到我們學校演講。她一開始先講了一個怪異的事實：有些青蛙冬天會結凍，到了春天又活過來。她也說明狗的嗅覺非常敏銳，比我們人類強得多。她的演講內容很平衡，既有有趣的故事，也有嚴肅的資訊。快結束時，她放了森林被砍伐的照片，臉色變得很凝重。接著火災警報器因為測試響了起來，演講就突然結束了。幸好她下一場演講的票價很合理，所以我們也能去聽。

questions.questionZh: 科學家一開始說了什麼怪事？
options: 有些青蛙冬天結凍春天復活

items.promptZh: 這間小餐廳的菜出奇地便宜。
referenceEn: The food at this small restaurant is remarkably cheap.
This small restaurant's food is remarkably cheap.
rubricZh: remarkably 修飾形容詞（例如 remarkably cheap 等）
時態配合內容（例如 is、was 等）

items.promptZh: 我昨晚做了一個很奇怪的夢。
referenceEn: I had a bizarre dream last night.
Last night, I had a really bizarre dream.
rubricZh: bizarre 可放名詞前或 be 動詞後（例如 a bizarre dream、was bizarre 等）
「做夢」可寫，例如 had a dream 等；用過去式；last night 可放句首或句尾
